grammarFocus: was / were；常用过去式入门；be going to；because；基础句型综合复习。
title: Lin's Busy Week
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。这是一个模拟练习，不是官方考试。请仔细阅读短文，并根据短文内容选择或填写答案。填空题请用短文中的原词，不超过字数限制。
passage: Lin is a student in Beijing. Last week, she was very busy. On Monday, she was at school. She was in the library because she had a test. On Tuesday, she was at home because she was sick. On Wednesday, she was at the doctor. On Thursday, she was at the park with her friend. They were happy because the weather was nice. On Friday, she was at the cinema. The movie was good. Now, Lin is going to study for a test. She is going to study because the test is on Monday. She is going to study at home. She is going to study with her friend. They are going to study together.

grammar.title: 过去时与将来计划
grammar.explanation: 英语中，表示过去的状态用 was/were。例如：I was at home. She was busy. 表示计划做某事用 be going to。例如：I am going to study. She is going to study. because 表示原因，例如：She was happy because the weather was nice.
grammar.example: She was in the library because she had a test.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：I ___ at home yesterday.
questions.explanation: 主语是 I，过去时用 was。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：They ___ happy because the weather was nice.
questions.explanation: 主语是 They，过去时用 were。
questions.evidence: They were happy because the weather was nice.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：She ___ going to study for a test.
questions.explanation: 主语是 She，be going to 结构用 is。
questions.evidence: She is going to study for a test.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：I am going to study ___ the test is on Monday.
questions.explanation: because 表示原因，这里表示“因为考试在星期一”。
questions.evidence: I am going to study because the test is on Monday.

part1: What are you going to do tomorrow?

speaking.part2: Describe a busy day you had last week. You should say: where you were, what you did, why you were busy, and how you felt.
part3: Do you often have busy days?
What are you going to do next weekend?

transfer.writing: 写一篇短文，介绍你上周的一天和这周的计划。用上 was/were, be going to, because。至少5句话。
